admin.audit.error.en: Could not load the audit log. Check that the backend is running.

admin.audit.subtitle.en: Every change an admin made, and every blocked attempt to open the admin area.

admin.errors.generic.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

admin.errors.network.en: Cannot reach the server. Is the backend running?

admin.errors.noAccess.en: No access. This account is not an admin, so you have been signed out.

admin.overview.empty.en: No users yet. Numbers appear here as soon as people sign up.

admin.overview.error.en: Could not load the numbers. Check that the backend is running.

admin.overview.soon.runs.note.en: Counted once job research runs exist (TIQ-16).

admin.privacy.allowedExplain.en: Allowed: every user's profile data may be sent to the AI provider. Use only with a paid AI tier whose privacy terms were verified.

admin.privacy.blockedExplain.en: Blocked: only test accounts (fictional data) can use AI features that send profile data. Real users see a message that the feature is not available yet.

admin.privacy.changeMessage.en: The setting goes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Your reason is saved with your account and the time, and shown in the history and the audit log.

admin.privacy.confirmAllow.en: I confirm KOBANIQ uses a paid AI tier and the privacy requirements have been verified.

admin.privacy.error.en: Could not load the setting. Check that the backend is running.

admin.privacy.reasonHint.en: Required: why the setting is changed (10 to 500 characters).

admin.privacy.statusLabel.en: Sending real users' profile data to the AI

admin.privacy.subtitle.en: Controls whether real users' profile data may be sent to the AI provider (for example to write CVs).

admin.privacy.tooLong.en: The reason can be at most 500 characters.

admin.privacy.tooShort.en: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.

admin.regions.error.en: Could not load the regions. Check that the backend is running.

admin.regions.subtitle.en: City suggestions users see when they filter jobs. One city per line.

admin.regions.tooLong.en: A city name can be at most 60 characters.

admin.sources.badPriority.en: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000.

admin.sources.blocked.adapter.en: No adapter in the server yet

admin.sources.confirm.disable.en: Switch off {{name}}? Users can no longer choose it, and it is not searched.

admin.sources.confirm.enable.en: Switch on {{name}}? Users can choose it for job research right away.

admin.sources.empty.en: No job sources yet. The team adds a source as an adapter in the server plus a database record.

admin.sources.error.en: Could not load the job sources. Check that the backend is running.

admin.sources.priorityLabel.en: Order in the app (0–1000, lower first)

admin.sources.subtitle.en: Where job research looks for jobs. A source can only be switched on after its terms were checked and the server has an adapter for it.

admin.users.confirm.delete.en: Delete {{email}} for good? This cannot be undone.

admin.users.confirm.makeAdmin.en: Make {{email}} an admin? They get full access to this dashboard.

admin.users.confirm.makeUser.en: Make {{email}} a normal user? They lose access to this dashboard.

admin.users.confirm.reactivate.en: Reactivate {{email}}? They can log in again.

admin.users.confirm.suspend.en: Suspend {{email}}? They are signed out on every device and cannot log in until reactivated.

admin.users.error.en: Could not load users. Check that the backend is running.

admin.users.testAccountHint.en: Test accounts hold fictional data and may use AI features that send profile data while AI privacy is Blocked.

admin.users.testDialogOff.en: Remove the test account mark from {{email}}? AI features that send profile data then follow the AI privacy setting.

admin.users.testDialogOn.en: Mark {{email}} as a test account? Use only for accounts that hold fictional data.

admin.users.testOff.en: {{email}} is no longer a test account.

admin.users.you.en: This is your own account. Another admin must change it.

common.sourceReasons.needs_approval.en: Waiting for approval from the source (free API access requested).

common.sourceReasons.needs_permission.en: Its terms do not allow this use without the source’s written permission.

common.sourceReasons.no_free_api.en: No free, permitted way to read its public jobs; KOBANIQ does not search it.

common.sourceReasons.not_enabled.en: Ready, but not switched on yet.

common.sourceReasons.not_relevant.en: Free, but its jobs are not open to candidates in Somaliland or Somalia.

common.sourceReasons.terms_unverified.en: Its terms could not be checked yet, so it is not searched.

mobile.auth.errors.codeInvalid.en: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.

mobile.auth.errors.emailTaken.en: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.

mobile.auth.errors.generic.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

mobile.auth.errors.suspended.en: This account is suspended. Contact support.

mobile.auth.errors.tooManyAttempts.en: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.

mobile.auth.language.subtitle.en: You can change it any time in Settings.

mobile.auth.later.google.en: Google sign-in arrives in a later update.

mobile.auth.login.passwordChanged.en: Your password was changed. Log in with your new password.

mobile.auth.login.subtitle.en: Log in to see your matches and continue your assessments.

mobile.auth.onboarding.cv.body.en: Build a CV for each job from your real profile, in English or Somali. Nothing is invented, and you approve it before you export.

mobile.auth.onboarding.jobs.body.en: Search the job sources you choose in Somaliland, Somalia and remote. Every match tells you why it fits — and which skills are missing.

mobile.auth.onboarding.jobs.explanation.en: Matches 4 of 5 required skills. Missing: GraphQL.

mobile.auth.onboarding.skills.body.en: Take short adaptive quizzes to verify your skills — always optional. Results measure knowledge, not proof of real-world experience.

mobile.auth.placeholder.body.en: This screen is built in the next part of this task.

mobile.auth.reset.subtitle.en: Enter the code we sent to {{email}} and your new password.

mobile.auth.verify.resendIn.en: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s

mobile.auth.verify.subtitle.en: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it to confirm your email.

mobile.auth.welcome.body.en: AI-powered career intelligence: verify what you know, discover real jobs that fit, and build tailored CVs.

mobile.auth.welcome.tagline.en:
Know Your Skills.
Find Your Opportunity.

mobile.cv.edit.factsNote.en: Job titles, employers, dates, schools, skills and languages come from your profile. To change them, edit your profile and generate the CV again.

mobile.cv.edit.newVersionNote.en: This CV is approved. Saving makes a new draft version; the approved one stays.

mobile.cv.edit.subtitle.en: Change how your CV is worded. Facts come from your profile.

mobile.cv.edit.tooLong.en: Each bullet point can be at most 300 characters.

mobile.cv.errors.network.en: Cannot reach the server, or it took too long. Check your internet connection and try again.

mobile.cv.generate.addEmail.en: Add the email for your CVs

mobile.cv.generate.languageHint.en: Choose the language of this CV. It can differ from the app language.

mobile.cv.generate.writing.en: The AI is writing your CV from your profile. This can take up to a minute.

mobile.cv.job.detailsHint.en: What the AI found in the job ad.

mobile.cv.job.notFound.en: This job ad could not be found. It may have been deleted.

mobile.cv.job.pdfHint.en: A PDF of the job ad, up to 5 MB.

mobile.cv.job.pdfTooLarge.en: This PDF is larger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller file or paste the text.

mobile.cv.job.privacy.en: Only the job ad is sent to the AI, never your profile.

mobile.cv.job.reading.en: The AI is reading the job ad. This can take up to a minute.

mobile.cv.job.subtitle.en: Paste the job advertisement or upload it as a PDF. The AI reads the requirements.

mobile.cv.job.textPlaceholder.en: Paste the whole job ad here

mobile.cv.job.tooLong.en: The job ad is too long (at most 20,000 characters).

mobile.cv.job.tooShort.en: Paste the whole job ad (at least 50 characters).

mobile.cv.missing.hint.en: The CV leaves these out. Add them to your profile, then tap Generate again.

mobile.cv.quizOffer.body.en: This job asks for {{skill}}. A short quiz can confirm your level. It is optional; you can create the CV either way.

mobile.cv.quizOffer.saved.en: Quiz saved: {{skill}} is now assessed as {{level}}. You can create the CV now.

mobile.cv.tab.emptyBody.en: Tap New CV, paste a job ad or upload it as a PDF, and KOBANIQ writes a CV for that job from your profile.

mobile.cv.tab.loadError.en: Your CVs could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.

mobile.cv.tab.subtitle.en: A CV for each job, written from your profile in English or Somali.

mobile.cv.view.approveHint.en: Check the CV, edit the wording if needed, then approve it to download it as a PDF.

mobile.cv.view.approvedNotice.en: Approved. You can now download it as a PDF.

mobile.cv.view.deleteConfirm.en: Delete this CV? This cannot be undone.

mobile.cv.view.deleteFailed.en: The CV could not be deleted. Please try again.

mobile.cv.view.editHintApproved.en: Editing makes a new draft version; this approved CV stays as it is.

mobile.cv.view.noShare.en: This phone cannot open the share sheet. The PDF was saved in the app.

mobile.cv.view.notFound.en: This CV could not be found. It may have been deleted.

mobile.home.cvs.empty.en: No CVs yet. Your CVs will appear here.

mobile.home.error.generic.en: Your overview could not be loaded. Please try again.

mobile.home.error.network.en: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.

mobile.home.profileCard.body.en: A complete profile gives better CVs and job matches.

mobile.home.schedule.empty.en: No scheduled search. You can let KOBANIQ search for jobs on a schedule later.

mobile.home.skillCard.empty.en: No skills yet. Add your skills, then take a short test to show employers what you really know.

mobile.home.skillCard.someSelf_one.en: {{count}} skill is self-reported. A short optional quiz can confirm it.

mobile.home.skillCard.someSelf_other.en: {{count}} skills are self-reported. A short optional quiz can confirm them.

mobile.home.topMatch.empty.en: No job matches yet. Start a job search to see jobs that fit you.

mobile.interview.averageNote.en: The scores rate your answers for practice, not you as a person or your chance of being hired.

mobile.interview.loadError.en: This practice could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

mobile.interview.practiseForJob.en: Practise an interview for this job

mobile.interview.privacy.en: Your answers are sent to a free AI service for feedback. Do not write your name, phone number, address, ID numbers or other personal details — describe your experience in general terms.

mobile.interview.privacyShort.en: Don’t include personal details (names, phone numbers, addresses).

mobile.interview.start.noJobAds.en: No saved job ads yet. Add one in the CV tab, or open a job in Jobs and tap “Practise an interview”.

mobile.interview.start.roleHint.en: For example: Data officer, Nurse, Accountant

mobile.interview.start.subtitle.en: Answer questions in writing and get feedback on each answer.

mobile.interview.start.wait.en: Writing the questions can take up to a minute.

mobile.interview.typeHints.behavioral.en: “Tell me about a time when…” questions about how you worked with others and handled problems.

mobile.interview.typeHints.general.en: Common questions most employers ask: motivation, strengths, goals.

mobile.interview.typeHints.job_specific.en: Questions for one job: a job ad you saved in the CV tab, or a job you opened in Jobs.

mobile.interview.typeHints.problem_solvi.en: Short work situations: explain how you would solve them.

mobile.interview.typeHints.technical.en: Questions that test the knowledge the job needs.

mobile.jobs.detail.applyNote.en: You apply on the employer’s or source’s own site. KOBANIQ never applies for you.

mobile.jobs.detail.confidence.estimated.en: Your level is an estimate: some experience has no description of your responsibilities.

mobile.jobs.detail.confidence.unknown.en: Your level is unknown: add your experience to your profile.

mobile.jobs.detail.missingPreferred.en: Useful skills you don’t show yet

mobile.jobs.detail.missingRequired.en: Essential skills you don’t show yet

mobile.jobs.detail.noDeadline.en: No deadline given by the source

mobile.jobs.detail.notPosted.en: The source gives no publication date. KOBANIQ first found it on {{date}}.

mobile.jobs.detail.notRecommended.en: This job does not fit your profile well. See why below.

mobile.jobs.filters.cityHint.en: For example: Hargeisa. Only jobs in this city are shown.

mobile.jobs.filters.employerTypesHint.en: None chosen: all employers. Jobs from career-page links are listed as “Other”.

mobile.jobs.reasons.levelEstimated.en: Your career level is an estimate.

mobile.jobs.reasons.levelNotStated.en: The job doesn’t say which career level it is for.

mobile.jobs.reasons.levelUnknown.en: Your career level is not known yet.

mobile.jobs.reasons.level_above.en: This {{jobLevel}} job is well above your level ({{userLevel}}).

mobile.jobs.reasons.level_below.en: This {{jobLevel}} job is below your level ({{userLevel}}).

mobile.jobs.reasons.level_stretch.en: This {{jobLevel}} job is one step above your level ({{userLevel}}).

mobile.jobs.reasons.level_unknown.en: The job’s career level could not be compared with yours.

mobile.jobs.reasons.notRecommendedSkills.en: Not recommended: essential skills are missing.

mobile.jobs.reasons.skillsMissing.en: Essential skills you don’t show yet: {{skills}}.

mobile.jobs.reasons.titleWanted.en: Its title matches a job title you want.

mobile.jobs.research.noSources.en: No job source can be searched for these regions right now.

mobile.jobs.results.scoreNote.en: The score shows how relevant the job is to your profile, not your chance of being hired.

mobile.jobs.run.hiddenByFilters_other.en: {{count}} jobs found did not match your filters (they are kept for later searches).

mobile.jobs.run.status.failed.en: The sources could not be read.

mobile.jobs.run.status.partial.en: Some sources could not be read; the others were checked.

mobile.jobs.run.summary.en: {{found}} jobs found in total, {{new}} of them not seen before by KOBANIQ.

mobile.jobs.run.wait.en: You can leave this screen; the search keeps going.

mobile.jobs.saveFailed.en: Could not change your saved jobs. Try again.

mobile.jobs.savedEmptyBody.en: Tap Save on a job to keep it here.

mobile.jobs.search.noneStoredBody.en: KOBANIQ only shows real jobs it has found. Try other filters, or start a new search of the job sources.

mobile.jobs.search.noneStoredTitle.en: No stored jobs match these filters

mobile.jobs.search.regionsHint.en: None chosen: your preferred regions. Remote jobs are always included.

mobile.jobs.subtitle.en: Find jobs that fit your skills and experience, with the reasons.

mobile.preview.job.explanation.en: Matches 4 of 5 required skills: React Native, TypeScript, Git, REST APIs.

mobile.profile.deleteConfirm.en: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.

mobile.profile.hints.contactEmail.en: Shown on your CVs. Your login email does not change.

mobile.profile.hints.endDate.en: Leave empty if you still work here

mobile.profile.itemGone.en: This entry no longer exists. Go back to see your list.

mobile.profile.languageError.generic.en: The language changed on this phone, but it could not be saved to your account. Please choose it again.

mobile.profile.languageError.network.en: The language changed on this phone, but it could not be saved to your account. Check your internet connection and choose it again.

mobile.profile.languageHint.en: The app and messages from KOBANIQ use this language on all your devices.

mobile.profile.loadError.en: Your profile could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.

mobile.profile.personalHint.en: Employers see this on your CVs. Only you can see and change it.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.languages.en: Languages you speak and how well.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.preferences.en: What kind of job you are looking for. Job research uses this.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.projects.en: Things you built or worked on.

mobile.quiz.cancelled.en: This quiz was cancelled. Your skill did not change.

mobile.quiz.disclaimer.en: Quiz results measure knowledge, not proof of real-world experience.

mobile.quiz.leave.text.en: Leave the quiz? Your answers are kept and you can continue later, or cancel it.

mobile.quiz.notFound.en: This quiz could not be found.

mobile.quiz.report.harder.en: Try the quiz again at a harder level.

mobile.quiz.report.levelNote.en: Saved on your {{skill}} skill. Your own rating stays as you set it.

mobile.quiz.report.noGaps.en: No gaps found in this quiz.

mobile.quiz.report.noStrengths.en: No topic fully right this time.

mobile.quiz.report.practise.en: Practise {{topic}}, then take the quiz again.

mobile.quiz.start.noSkills.en: Add a skill first, then you can take a quiz on it.

mobile.quiz.start.privacy.en: Only the skill name is sent to the AI, never your profile.

mobile.quiz.start.subtitle.en: A short, optional quiz to confirm one of your skills.

mobile.quiz.start.writing.en: The AI is writing your questions. This can take up to a minute.

mobile.skills.loadError.en: Your skills could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.

mobile.skills.onlyQuiz.en: Only a quiz changes the assessed level. It measures knowledge, not work experience.

mobile.skills.quizThis.en: Take a quiz on this skill

mobile.skills.suggestBody.en: A short quiz can confirm your level. It is always optional.

mobile.soon.jobs.body.en: Soon you can choose regions and job sources in Somaliland and Somalia and get jobs that match you, each with an explanation.

mobile.soon.reports.body.en: Reports on your CVs, tests and job searches appear once you start using those features.

server.email.resetPassword.body.en:
Hello,

Your KOBANIQ password reset code is: {{code}}

Enter it in the app to choose a new password. The code works for {{minutes}} minutes.

If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.

KOBANIQ

server.email.verifyEmail.body.en:
Hello,

Your KOBANIQ verification code is: {{code}}

Enter it in the app to confirm your email. The code works for {{minutes}} minutes.

If you did not create a KOBANIQ account, you can ignore this email.

KOBANIQ
